lines.text: Feel the electricity when you're near,
Igniting fires, crystal clear.
Sends shivers down my spine,
This moment, yours and mine.
Pulse quickens, can't deny,
Under the sky, you and I.
Spark of love, lighting up the dark,
Hit my heart, leave your mark.
Burning strong, day and night,
Spark of love, feels so right.
Secrets shared in hushed tones,
Eyes speak volumes, no words needed,
This flame's seeded.
Heat rises, passions flow,
Let it grow.
Spark of love, lighting up the dark,
Hit my heart, leave your mark.
Burning strong, day and night,
Spark of love, feels so right.
